Nadia: Quick pet photo drop  Ghibli built a blanket fort on my laptop and refuses to move. photo: https://cdn.redwood.app/ghibli/3412345678_ghibli_fort.jpg
Tom: 60d official fort inspector reporting for duty. Does it have a moat?
Priya: That is an ambitious fort. Did you pay rent or is the cat squatting?
Nadia: Squatting. Hes claimed the south wing (the corner with the warm charger).
Elliot: :joy: the gaze says "i will accept tributes of snacks and pens"
Nadia: Uploaded a short clip of him rearranging the pillows  https://cdn.redwood.app/ghibli/3412345678_ghibli_fort_loop.mp4
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "ghibli_fort_loop.mp4"  https://cdn.redwood.app/ghibli/3412345678_ghibli_fort_loop.mp4
Tom: watched 440 0:03 when he does the tiny paw sweep = heart-melting.
Priya: poll: do we crown Ghibli blanket monarch? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Elliot: :thumbsup: yes (long live the King)
Tom: :thumbsup:
Nadia: saving this thread for when i need a productivity excuse. also taking nominations for throne name. suggestions: "Sir Warmpaws", "Baron of Blankets"
Priya: Sir Warmpaws wins.
